verdict.rationale: Lium documents clusters as several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric for one distributed job. That is a first-party form of interconnect between machines, but only within a cluster, not general private networking between arbitrary pods. Nothing in the evidence shows exposing ports to serve applications from a pod; the Jupyter toggle is an adjacent feature and does not count. missing for 10: documented port exposure or public endpoints for serving apps, general private networking between independent pods, network configuration details, independent corroboration.
